2026-11-17 — Settings gear in the header, /diag status, self-hosted fonts

Before (left) and after (right), captured by the fleet audit at 1366×900 and 390×844 with the app on Development and Key Vault blanked.

1. Header, desktop 1366px

After: a ⚙ Settings link sits immediately left of the account badge (red box). Settings left the account menu. Before, the console logged two CORS errors for the Google-hosted fonts; after, zero (fonts are served from /fonts).

2. Header, phone 390px

After: the gear and the initial disc share the right-hand slot on the one-row bar; the decorative caret is dropped on phones to make room.

3. /diag

After: an overall banner, a Refresh button that is disabled while it runs, version and environment, and API / Database-storage / Services sections with status, purpose, latency and last-checked time, all from GET /api/diag. The masked Key Vault and Foundry endpoints and raw exception messages are gone.
